description: This file implements a GzipSourceStream class for handling gzip and deflate compressed data streams, including header detection, decompression, and stream state management.

classes.name: GzipSourceStream
classes.description: A class for decompressing gzip and deflate streams, managing headers, footers, and decompression states.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a GzipSourceStream instance with initialization.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the zlib stream for decompression based on stream type.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stream type (GZIP or DEFLATE).

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Processes input data, performs decompression, and manages stream states.

methods.name: InsertZlibHeader
methods.description: Attempts to insert a zlib header into the stream if missing.
